'''Imperial Prison ISO-L8''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] station on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], near [[Recopia]].

==History==
Construction began on Imperial Prison ISO-L8 at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was previously a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fuel depot. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] visited the station later to interrogate [[Janks]] only to find he had been killed by [[Falco Sang]].
